momentum_home.summary: Mixed run capped by a 1-0 home defeat to Beitar three days before the derby, with a red card to Kancepolsky compounding the pain.

momentum_away.summary: Strong April form interrupted by 4-2 loss at Beitar, then bounced back with 4-0 thrashing of Hapoel Petah Tikva on May 5.

home.label: anxious
home.summary: Supporters frustrated after losing to Beitar at home and slipping in the title race; pressure on Barda to deliver in the derby.

away.label: split
away.summary: Maccabi fans buoyed by the 1-0 derby win in April but title hopes faded after the Beitar 4-2 loss left them 9 points off the top.

expected_attendance: near capacity (~28000-29000 at Bloomfield, high-security derby)

stakes.home: Fighting to hold a Conference League / European spot, also seeking a derby win to ease the disappointment of the Beitar loss and the points deduction.
stakes.away: Title hopes mathematically alive but fading (9 pts behind Beitar); must win to keep external pressure on the leaders.

h2h_and_venue.last_5_h2h: Maccabi has dominated long-term but Hapoel won 2-1 in January 2026; Maccabi replied 1-0 in April 2026 and 3-0 in October 2025.
h2h_and_venue.home_form_at_home: Strong at Bloomfield until the recent 0-1 loss to Beitar - first home defeat of the season.
h2h_and_venue.away_form_on_road: Solid away form under Deila with notable 4-1 win at Hapoel Haifa, vulnerable as shown in 4-2 loss at Beitar.

market_odds.divergence_vs_sim: unknown — market data not gathered for match 1

simulation_phases.p1_0_15: Hapoel come out emotionally charged at home in front of a hostile derby crowd; expect a high-press, high-intensity opening. Maccabi look to absorb and counter through Sahiti and Varela on the flanks. xG roughly even (~0.15 each).
simulation_phases.p2_15_45: Maccabi typically settle and dominate possession; with Peretz orchestrating and Sahiti's set-piece threat, they generate the better chances. Hapoel without Kancepolsky struggle in transitions. xG edge to Maccabi ~0.6 vs ~0.35.
simulation_phases.p3_45_60: Barda likely makes a halftime tactical tweak. Hapoel come out with renewed urgency in front of the home end. Phase fairly even.
simulation_phases.p4_60_75: Substitutions become decisive — Maccabi's bench is deeper. Game state tilts to Maccabi if leading.
simulation_phases.p5_75_90: If level, Hapoel throw bodies forward; Maccabi's experience and need to keep title math alive favors them in the closing minutes.

key_factors: Maccabi superior squad depth and recent derby winners
Hapoel coming off a home loss to Beitar
Maccabi must-win for fading title chase
Bloomfield derby crowd boost for hosts
Peretz in red-hot scoring form (14 league goals)
narrative: Maccabi Tel Aviv arrive at Bloomfield as the technically superior side with a sharper attack led by captain Dor Peretz, and a recent 1-0 derby win in the bag. Hapoel Tel Aviv are wounded — a 1-0 home loss to Beitar three days earlier, suspensions to Kancepolsky and Leidner, and the 2-point deduction all sap momentum. Maccabi needs the win to keep title hopes mathematically alive. The derby's emotional charge narrows the gap — draws and one-goal games are realistic — but on balance Maccabi shade it.
